# Vendored libraries

## qrcode.js

- Library: [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) v1.4.4 (npm package, unmodified)
- Author: Kazuhiko Arase
- License: MIT (see header of `qrcode.js`)

It is vendored rather than loaded from a CDN so the app has no runtime dependency on third-party services
and keeps working offline once loaded.
